title: Run local backup/restore and disaster-recovery rehearsal

environment.profile: local Docker disaster-recovery rehearsal; synthetic data only

BIO-OPS-009-AC01.finding: Control-plane and tenant databases are backed up separately and restored into distinct fresh containers and volumes; complete restored rows match independent pre-backup snapshots exactly.

BIO-OPS-009-AC02.finding: The documented rehearsal creates fresh standalone containers and refuses pre-existing restore volume names; interruption tests prove cleanup removes partial restore resources.

BIO-OPS-009-AC03.finding: Azurite photo/object fixtures restore byte-exactly by SHA-256, post-backup blobs remain absent, archive failures and real SIGTERM restore the source service to health.

BIO-OPS-009-AC04.finding: Three final live rehearsals record measured per-store recovery point objective windows, exact lost row/blob identifiers and local recovery time objective, explicitly disclaimed as non-production service levels.

commands.result: PASS (21/21 unrestricted; acceptance sandbox replay 17/17 structural with 4 Docker checks skipped because the daemon is unavailable)

disclosures: The rehearsal uses synthetic seed rows and blobs because current application repositories remain in memory and are not wired to these local stores.
Measured recovery point and recovery time figures are single-laptop local observations, not production service-level objectives or capacity claims.

final_acceptance.reason: All four acceptance criteria map to executable tests and retained exact-commit evidence. Independent review closed full-row integrity, cleanup/reuse, archive-failure, signal-interruption and measured-RPO gaps; final live Docker evidence passes 21/21 with clean teardown.
